description: This file defines an interface 'FilterFieldExpressionVisitor' which extends another visitor interface. It specifies methods for visiting various parts of a FilterFieldExpression in a query DSL, acting as a compositional interpreter for such expressions.

classes.name: FilterFieldExpressionVisitor
classes.description: An interface for visiting and interpreting parts of a FilterFieldExpression in a query model for Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Visits an attribute by its key in a filter expression.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Visits a feature ID property with its feature ID and property name.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Visits a simple field identified by its name.
